title: Why Most Leaders Feel Lonely
text: whenever you decide to become yourself you become lonely right because everyone around you want you to be like them or they want you to be them so when you discover that you are unique you are special you are important and you decide to become who you are and Achieve what you're dreaming loneliness is the result uh be and I say this many times and in my books I write about this that every true vision only has one believer first and it's the person who have the vision wow and that's what makes it lonely but what attracts people to you is when you decide that you don't care if you're lonely you're still going to pursue the vision I'm sure so it's the desire to to to use your aloneness properly that makes people come to you you're no longer alone and so I I have been alone most of the time I'm lonely now because a leader is always lonely because they are out front there's no one out there with them when you think about it if you have anyone around you then you're part of the crowd that's true so leaders are they live a lonely life but they they chose that loneliness and that's important you have to choose to be alone if you're going to change the world and every great leader in history as you study them they really found their true self and they was alone you know Moses was in the wilderness Jesus Christ in the desert Paul went to the desert you know and uh so when you when you pursue something that that is more important than the crowd you end up leading the crowd wow someone said you cannot lead an orchestra unless you turn your back to the crowd think about it for a minute yeah so if you're going to be the leader you're going to turn your back on the crowd and then you can lead life
